quote: You keep searching for peace in crowded rooms. Every corner hides a version of you left behind. The noise outside only echoes the silence within. You cannot outrun the shadow of your own making. Stop hiding from the quiet truth waiting in the dark. Only when you surrender the fight does healing begin.
